title: Herbal Custard Quinua Pudding
description: A sweet and soothing dessert featuring quinua, herbal flavors, and a creamy custard.
instructions: 1. In a medium saucepan, combine quinua and herbal tea. Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until quinua is tender.
2. In a separate saucepan, warm the custard over low heat, stirring occasionally.
3. Add the sugar, melted butter, vanilla extract, and salt to the quinua mixture. Stir to combine.
4. Fold the warmed custard into the quinua mixture until well combined.
5. Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or ramekins.
6. Refrigerate until chilled, at least 2 hours.
7. Top with whipped cream, if desired.
